title: Call the Orchard Core API With Client Credentials | Orchard Core
description:
A scheduled import, a build step or another service runs without a person, so it cannot sign in with a password. The OpenID Connect client credentials flow lets such a program sign in as an application, receive an access token, and call the Orchard Core Content API.

This video enables the authorization server and token validation, creates a role and an application, and writes the token request and the Content API calls in C#.

In this video:
• How the client credentials flow works
• Enabling the authorization server and token validation, and allowing the flow
• Creating a role with the permissions of the application
• Registering the application with its client ID, secret and role
• Requesting an access token from the token endpoint
• Creating, reading, updating and deleting content with a bearer token, and the permission each call needs
• Checking the result in the admin
• Understanding unauthorized, forbidden and refused requests
